Pitch Counter & Radar Gun is the ultimate baseball, softball, and fastpitch utility app for iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS. This app bundles a pitch counter, radar gun (speed calculator), and scoreboard with an easy-to-use interface, making it the perfect tool for coaches, parents, players, and enthusiasts.

Main Features:
• Simple & easy to use pitch counter (great for Little League)
• Multiple modes allow the ability to track balls and strikes and breakdown by innings
• Radar Gun (speed calculator) with the ability to customize pitching distances
• View speed statistics (average, fastest, and slowest speeds)
• Simple scoreboard to keep track of score, inning, and number of outs. 
• Supports all iOS devices and works great on iPads
• Apple Watch App

Designed with user-friendliness in mind, Pitch Counter & Radar Gun is perfect for both beginners and experienced users. If you have any suggestions for future updates or improvements, please reach out to us through the app!
